reviews.title: App won’t open
reviews.text: I paid 40 bucks for this and three months later the app won’t open anymore. Don’t buy it

reviews.title: Horrible trash
reviews.text: Every single time you leave the app and come back there is a popup that pushes you to buy premium

reviews.title: Now I have to pay?
